initialization: Actual public start/observe callbacks; initialization costs reported separately and identical across methods. Initial material is explicitly disclosed; no free seed checks.
candidate_rule: Finite material recipes. Read each exact ID once. Checks target observed material only, with explicit named dependencies/checkers. Factories inspect State only and never oracle labels or future observations.
baseline_rule: All main methods use the same public run/step with full pool and current common safety/necessity/helper gates. Only selector ranking changes: declaration order, verify-first or seed17 random. This is conditional ranking value, not whole-stack scheduler superiority.
checker_rule: Parse raw JSON integers/declared rules; compute numeric condition. Special unknown/corrupt inputs produce UNKNOWN/FAIL from raw data. Local CSV/JSON uses actual bytes.
oracle_rule: Independent raw arithmetic/exact Decimal/file contract and exact current target/scope/contract/dependency/checker/purpose/resolution fingerprint/receipt checks. Least grounded positive proof; every distinct active required target must be validated, positive aliases collapse while exact negative IDs remain. No plan, coverage, make_basis or private acceptance predicates; finite recipes are DAG dependencies, general cyclic alternatives are runtime regressions.

family_rules.F1: Repeated and distinct declared origins, 2/3 required origins, invalid raw numbers and unknown declared origin, tight/adequate continuation budgets.
family_rules.F2: Cross-obligation rules, satisfied or optional helper, exact-ID duplicate dependency, 1/2 stages, tight/adequate budgets and unrelated material.
family_rules.F3: 1/2/3 required checkers, partial initialized PASS; dedicated self-verification branch has prohibited checker-0 with allowed checker-1 and no named required checker; unavailable checker and capacity 1/2/4.
family_rules.F4: Actual callback history and explicit initial contradiction resolution, then contract revision and re-resolution; host evidence/check invalidation, dependency update, unrelated host seed addition; new invalidation API explicitly unsupported in 0.2.0.
family_rules.F5: Actual FAIL/UNKNOWN history, equal-byte aliases, exact and wrong-alias check resolution, contradiction-specific resolution and unavailable resolution checker.
family_rules.F6: Simple 1/2/3-source fixed pipeline, valid/invalid data, initialized completion and adequate/tight budgets; direct pipeline reference.
family_rules.F7: Missing material/checker, throwing callback/factory, invalid receipt, unknown actual use, no-op and insufficient budget; abstention expected.
family_rules.F8: Local CSV/JSON varying row count, exact Decimal boundaries, duplicates, UTF-8 BOM/CRLF/Unicode path, maximal supported rows and snapshot continuation; direct pipeline reference.

budget_rule: Continuation limits: F1 actions=2 tight else8, verifications=sources(2/3), minimum2*(sources-1), unknown-origin mode3/invalid mode4 unsolvable; F2 actions=2 tight else10/verifications4, minimum3 or5 withstage; F3 actions=1 tight else6/verificationsN, partialinitialPASS whenN>1 exceptselfbranch mode2; minimum1 selfbranch else max(1,N-1), missinglastchecker mode3 unsolvable; F4 actions=1 tight else10/verifications4, modes minimum=[2,2,1,3,3,1], stricter-invalid mode4 unsolvable; F5 actions=0 tight else5/verifications3, minimum1 or2 withcontradiction, wrongalias/unavailable resolution unsolvable; F6 sources1 whenmode5 alreadycomplete else1/2/3, actions=1 tight else2*sources/verificationssources, minimum2*(sources-initialchecked), invalid mode4 unsolvable; F7 actions=2+(index%3)/verifications1, specified absent/fault/unknown/no-op tasks unsolvable; F8 actions4/verifications2, minimum4 validrawfiles, duplicateCSVheader mode4 index<12 else duplicateJSONkey. tight iff index%5==0. Numeric/file raw_world_valid is separate from authority/material/budget-aware solvable; initialization costs added equally to total SDK budget and disclosed.

scaling.instrumentation: Separate processes: count actual new base/worklist check/target work and final memo lookups versus old recursive entries with method-specific labels; uninstrumented timing; single tracemalloc memory replay, peak traced Python allocations not RSS. Whole-worker timeouts right-censored, phase unknown.

aggregation.primary: Oracle-confirmed completion/solvable parents, false-satisfied/all evaluated parents
aggregation.cluster: Parent task: variants and random seeds averaged within parent, never independent sample inflation
aggregation.cost: Known complete pairs: callback counts and normal controller wall/CPU plus paired parent bootstrap intervals; all-task success/failure costs separately. Any delay break-even is assumption-based sensitivity, never LLM/token/monetary measurement.
aggregation.stops: Unsolvable known incomplete domain stops, uncertain stops, execution faults, solvable erroneous stops, worker unexecuted/timeouts and oracle-unassessed outcomes are distinct. Runner stop spelling is not the classifier.

exclusions: No outcome-based exclusions. Errors, timeouts, unsupported old API, unexecuted budget-limited trials remain explicit rows. Solvable labels are raw-world and bound-aware, not router status. No LLMs, GPUs or external paid API.
holdout_rule: Freeze022 implementation/manifest/harness/wheel/env before formal regression/scaling/new confirmation. Regression is observed prior data, new49979687 graph/update seed unused. Changes to runtime/oracle/generator require new protocol and unused confirmation; preserve all old results.
deadline_scope: Identical whole-worker subprocess deadline for every method/variant/seed (startup/import/trial/serialization included); cap also limited by experiment time remaining. Native smoke direct calls are finite recipes. Timeout oracle/cost unknown, no fabricated zero; startup/import/IPC recorded separately.
measurement_rule: Normal time has no tracemalloc/profile. Time/count/peak traced allocations are separate processes. Windows Job whole-worker CPU and aggregate private committed memory include venv descendants; parent working set is separate. Imports/construction/transitions/progress/serialization identified; whole-worker censors do not imply plan-only lower bounds.
regression_rule: Use exact old holdout seed982451653/material specifications and original order only. Observed regression set, not unseen holdout. All four methods960 trials plus60 direct-pipeline references; no unexecuted variants/seed cluster intervals claimed.

budgets.enforcement: Workers launched suspended and assigned to private Windows Job before execution; sampled cumulative user+kernel Job CPU and peak aggregate private committed bytes. Terminate only owned Job at observed crossing; sample overshoot possible. Parent peak working set cap separate. Overall cumulative worker+parent CPU/wall caps retain unexecuted keys. Unavailable whole-worker accounting stops dependent execution rather than assuming zero.
budgets.per_worker_memory_metric: Windows Job peak aggregate private committed bytes, including venv redirector descendants; not RSS or working set

execution_order.rule: Serial workers only; no other heavy work during formal measurements. In each parent/input+mode block versions/methods are deterministically shuffled; all keys pre-enumerated. No outcome-driven reordering.

helper_scaling.scope: OR alternatives and AND material/checker prerequisites; excludes the consuming root as a circular justification. Exact bindings/permissions/budget/capacity are retained.

confirmation.scope: New generated topologies/alternatives/current-validity/checker/update conditions, separate from known regression; compare current allowed helper reachability to an independent finite reference and exact resolution-input correctness. ID/numeric permutations alone do not create parents.
